title: Implement a Multi-Stage Content Moderation System
description: CircleConnect Nexus is a growing social platform. To maintain a healthy community, a content moderation system is required. This task involves building the feature incrementally over three simulated development sessions. The system will allow users to report inappropriate posts, and administrators to review and act on these reports. The final stage will involve making the system configurable and robust against abuse.

project_spec.name: CircleConnect Nexus
project_spec.description:
CircleConnect Nexus is a large-scale social networking platform designed around community "circles" where users collaborate on events, shared purchases, and crowdsourced goals. Built with a strict Model–View–Controller skeleton, the application separates domain logic (circles, posts, pledges, events), delivery (RESTful JSON + server-rendered pages), and presentation (responsive SPA widgets) to keep user-driven features—such as real-time circle feeds, member voting, and pooled-payment pledges—safe, testable, and independently evolvable.  

The project stresses the social dimension by weaving collective interactions into every major user story: circles can open micro-funding campaigns, members can co-edit event schedules, and influence scores steer content visibility. Core requirements include SSL-everywhere transport, OAuth2 social log-ins, stripe-backed pledge payments, granular activity logging, and an admin observability panel—all orchestrated through Spring Boot MVC controllers, service components, repositories, and React/Thymeleaf hybrid views. With 52 target source files and ~335k tokens, the codebase offers a full spectrum of advanced social-app concerns: rate-limited REST endpoints, sophisticated validation layers, repository abstractions over PostgreSQL, adaptive UI, and an extensible middleware chain for authentication, session and error handling.
dependencies: Spring Boot (Web, Security, Data JPA, Validation)
Google / Facebook OAuth2 Client libraries (social login)
Apache Commons Validator / Hibernate Validator (data validation)
